alerts.reason: Take-Two’s December-quarter net bookings fell $73.9 million year over year as several titles sold less after their launch periods (B). Restrictions boosted player engagement (C), and Grand Theft Auto supplied 28.9% of nine-month net revenue (A). I expect online demand to keep the March-quarter revenue change above -5%, then the comparison with a full quarter of elevated engagement to push June-quarter net revenue down at least 5% year over year.

Pandemic-related PPE unit sales drove most of Fastenal’s 5.9% net sales growth in 2020, with little contribution from higher prices (A, B, D). Some PPE products were already oversupplied in the second half (C). I expect net sales growth to stay above -5% in the March quarter, then fall to -5% or lower in April–June as Fastenal compares against a full quarter of pandemic PPE demand.
